question.worked_solution:
We take the derivative of each term and then add them, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}\begin{aligned}{f}^{′}(x) & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}({x}^{2}-6csc⁡x) \\  & =2x-6(-csc⁡xcot⁡x) \\  & =2x+6csc⁡xcot⁡x\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$
